stories.headline: Wall Street posts best day since April 2025 after Nvidia reinstates Huang
stories.summary: The S&P 500 rose 4.7% to 7,237 on Monday, the Nasdaq Composite gained 6.5% and the Dow added about 1,448 points. Monday's gain recovered just over half of the previous week's 8.6% loss, during which the S&P 500 fell into correction territory. The VIX fell more than 9 points, and every S&P 500 sector except energy and consumer staples ended higher.

stories.headline: Chip stocks fall as investors test Nvidia-led rally
stories.summary: U.S. stocks fell on Tuesday as chip shares gave back part of Monday's gains. Nvidia was down about 6% to 8%, AMD fell between 8% and 12%, and Micron and Broadcom also declined. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was down about 8.5% in early trading. Renewed congressional scrutiny of Nvidia and questions about returns on AI spending and interest rates weighed on the sector.

stories.headline: Nvidia shares jump 31% after board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
stories.summary: Nvidia shares rose 31.5% to $165.05 on Monday, adding about $950 billion in market value. The gain came after the board voted unanimously to reinstate co-founder Jensen Huang as chief executive less than two weeks after his resignation. It was the stock's best day since 2003 and followed a 38% fall in November amid a spy-scandal probe and an SEC review of its accounting. President Trump said his administration had assured Nvidia that Huang's return raised no national security concerns.

stories.headline: Semiconductor index rises 14% as memory and AI chip stocks rebound
stories.summary: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose about 14% on Monday, and memory stocks gained about 18%. Micron rose about 19%, helped by new multi-year customer supply agreements, and Taiwan Semiconductor and AMD also closed sharply higher. The rebound came one session after the index fell 10.7% on Friday and was down 21% for November through that day.

stories.headline: Futures price December Fed hike as Treasury yields ease below 5%
stories.summary: Fed funds futures moved on Monday to price in a December rate hike, and the dollar firmed. The 10-year Treasury yield was near 4.9% on Tuesday, down from above 5.1% a week earlier, after New York Fed President John Williams warned about inflation. In our data, high-yield spreads widened by about 0.4 percentage points over the week to 3.76.

stories.headline: Oil falls to three-month low on hopes of U.S.-Iran talks
stories.summary: Brent crude fell below $89 a barrel on Tuesday, after closing on Monday at its lowest level since Aug. 31. U.S. crude traded near $80. Qatar said it was working to revive U.S.-Iran negotiations, and analysts said a geopolitical risk premium was being removed from prices, even as Iran reported tanker fires in the Strait of Hormuz.
